reviews.title: Great video’s and responsive developer
reviews.text: The video’s are easy to follow and the exercises, really good. A couple of things were not right for me as a user though. Rather than leaving a less than 5 star review based on my first couple of experiences, I reached out to the developer to flag a couple of issues, such as selecting out of exercises that included gym equipment nobody would have at home. I suggested there be modified exercises shown to target the same muscle group but included only body weight exercises. Or offering a toggle for “no gym equipment” or “body weight exercises only”. The developer was very responsive, let me know he was working on it, and let me know when the fix was completed and I could download the latest version. I really appreciated that.

reviews.title: Best Military Workout
reviews.text: On 12th day of the challenge, already seeing results. Besides challenge, I also love their playlists. Amazing job.

reviews.title: Does not move days
reviews.text: While I love the option of different exercises, I opted to do the 28 day challenge. It does not move to the next day. I have had to do day one twice and then it shows I skipped day 2. I am now on day 7 but it won’t actually show me the workout for day 7. It is stuck on day 6 and will not let me pick that day. So I am working out to day 5 again. It also gives workouts that include gym equipment which I do not have. I paid to have this app and am disappointed so far with its abilities.

reviews.title: Get something else
reviews.text: The exercises that were selected for my 28 day challenge are full of gym exercises and use equipment that no one at home would have. I am truly disappointed- I wanted a structure to build my at home routine but this isn’t it.  I sit through multiple exercises that I can’t do without having gym equipment and I can’t seem to modify or change the routines I was given.

reviews.title: It needs work
reviews.text: So when I say that it needs work and I think that it doesn’t listen very well I specifically win. It asked me the questions when I installed the app whether or not I was going to be doing this at home or at the gym I said at home, no equipment because I the only equipment I have is a yoga mat and small weights that does not mean I have a gym so the exercises that they do at the gym on are BS. And then on top of it it asks do you have any issues? I have a plastic kneecap so I put knee issues what does it give me almost every single day knee exercise exercises luckily I know Alternatives. DO BETTER. don’t say you can work for everyone if you’re not going to work with everyone.

reviews.title: Pay to play
reviews.text: They made it seem like there was a free option for use, they only give you one day of workouts… unless you purchase a premium subscription.  Good workouts, and great app idea, but deceptive marketing.
